title: 第9章 通背武馆第10章 通背桩
slug: 每日情报从打渔人开始武道通神
lines: 沈修寒大喜，浑身肌肉战栗着，猛地向上提竿！
这一次，几乎再没有传来像样的反抗。
“哗啦啦！”
水花四溅中，一条翻着白肚皮的硕大鱼影被拖出水面。
那鱼足有成年人手臂长，两只拳头拼在一起那般宽。
长相与银纹鱼大相径庭。
脊背上并非生着条纹，而是一整片犹如水银泻地般、闪烁着金属冷光的纯银之色。
而最令人心悸的是鱼吻前端，竟生着一根约莫手掌长短、尖锐无比的骨刺！
“终于拿下了…”
沈修寒长舒一口气，正要把这宝鱼拖上冰面。
这时，异变陡生！
看似力竭的银背鱼，以不可思议的角度从水面弹射而起！
鱼吻上锋利的尖刺，宛如离弦之箭，朝沈修寒脸上扎来！
“卧槽！”
沈修寒头皮一炸，瞬息间起了一层白毛汗！
太近了！
他来不及做出任何躲闪，全凭本能，下意识将手中的竹竿横在身前一挡！
“咔嚓！”
一声脆响，竹竿被骨刺从中撞断！
一股沛然巨力顺着断竿砸在他胸口，沈修寒脚下一滑，重重仰面摔倒在冰面上。
“刺啦！”
耳畔传来冰面破开的脆响。
手掌长的尖刺，贴着沈修寒的侧脸，齐根钉入他耳侧不到两寸的冰层里！
若非竹竿挡了一下，导致偏了准头。
银背鱼临死反扑的一击，此刻已洞穿他的头颅！
沈修寒惊出一身冷汗，心脏狂跳如鼓。
还未等他从死里逃生的惊惧中喘过气来。
半截身子钉在冰面上的银背鱼开始疯狂挣扎，粗壮有力的鱼尾在半空中左右乱甩。
可怜的沈修寒到底没能躲过这凶物的报复，被结结实实抽了两个大嘴巴子，火辣辣地疼。
“你这畜生！”
沈修寒勃然大怒！
连滚带爬地从冰面上扑到冰洞前，也顾不上寒冷，双手鞠起一捧带着冰碴的湖水，朝着还在扑腾的银背鱼身上泼去。
严寒在此刻展现了威力。
霎时间，冰水凝结。
这条狡猾凶悍的银背鱼，顷刻间被冻成一尊冰雕！
content_en:
Shen Xiuhan was overjoyed, his muscles trembled all over his body, and he suddenly lifted the rod upwards!
This time, there was almost no decent resistance.
"Crash!"
Amidst the splashing water, a huge fish silhouette with a white belly turned over was dragged out of the water.
The fish was as long as an adult's arm and as wide as two fists put together.
The appearance is quite different from that of the silver striped fish.
There are not stripes on the back, but a pure silver color that shines like a mercury field, shining with cold metallic light.
The most heart-stopping thing is that there is an extremely sharp bone spur about the length of a hand at the front of the fish's snout!
"Finally got it..."
Shen Xiuhan breathed a long sigh of relief and was about to drag the precious fish onto the ice.
At this time, a sudden change occurred!
The seemingly exhausted silverback ejected from the water at an incredible angle!
The sharp spikes on the fish's snout were like arrows from the string, piercing Shen Xiuhan's face!
"Fuck!"
Shen Xiuhan's scalp exploded, and a layer of white hair and sweat suddenly appeared!
Too close!
He didn't have time to dodge, so he relied on instinct and subconsciously held the bamboo pole in front of him to block it!
"Crack!"
There was a crisp sound, and the bamboo pole was broken by bone spurs!
A huge force hit his chest along the broken pole. Shen Xiuhan's foot slipped and he fell heavily on his back on the ice.
"Stab it!"
There was a crisp sound of ice breaking in my ears.
The spikes on the palm of his hand were pressed against the side of Shen Xiuhan's face, and they were driven into the ice less than two inches beside his ears!
If it weren't for the bamboo pole blocking it, causing the target to miss its target.
The silverback's deadly counterattack had now penetrated his head!
Shen Xiuhan broke out in a cold sweat and his heart beat like a drum.
Before he could take a breath from the horror of escaping from death.
The silverback fish, half of its body nailed to the ice, began to struggle wildly, its thick and powerful fish tail swaying left and right in the air.
"Pah, pah!"
Poor Shen Xiuhan was not able to escape the revenge of this vicious creature. He was slapped twice in the mouth, which was very painful.
"You beast!"
Shen Xiuhan was furious!
He rolled and crawled from the ice to the ice cave, not caring about the cold. He raised a handful of ice-crusted lake water with both hands and poured it on the still flopping silverback.
The severe cold showed its power at this moment.
In an instant, the ice water condensed.
This cunning and fierce silverback fish was instantly frozen into an ice sculpture!
